prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady walk along a rugged, gravelly path winding through a misty mountain landscape. The camera moves forward, capturing the uneven terrain as it ascends a gentle slope, flanked by lush green grass and scattered wildflowers. As the viewer progresses, the path curves slightly to the right, revealing a dense forest of tall pine trees in the distance, partially obscured by a thick layer of fog that blankets the area. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive view of the natural surroundings. The light is soft and diffused, casting a pale yellow hue over the scene, indicative of a cloudy day. The path continues to rise, and the camera pans slightly to the left, showcasing more of the verdant hillside. Eventually, a small wooden cabin comes into view, nestled among the trees on a higher elevation. The camera approaches the cabin, offering a closer look at its rustic exterior before panning back to the forested backdrop, emphasizing the serene and untouched beauty of Le Prarion, Chamonix-Mont-Blanc, France. Throughout the journey, the environment remains empty, enhancing the sense of solitude and tranquility.
